video_title: How does Ja Morant fit with the Portland Trail Blazers? 🤔 + NBA free agency news | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's trade to Portland and his fit with Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant and Damian Lillard will now be the starting backcourt of the Portland Trail Blazers.

text_blocks.speaker: David Lloyd
text_blocks.text: Ja Morant, he was like the foundational piece to this Grizzlies team a few years back and now he's dealt. What can you tell us about this?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: Seven years for Ja Morant in Memphis and just like that, it's over. The Grizzlies have been trying to find a trade destination for Ja Morant for the better part of the last six to eight months. They finally find one in Portland and it's a stunner because from a basketball fit, Ja Morant and Damian Lillard will now be the starting backcourt of the Portland Trail Blazers. This is a talent, high-upside swing for the Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's declining trade value due to injuries and availability
quotes.excerpt: Ja Morant's value around the league just had plummeted because of his play the last year.
quotes.quote: Over the last four, five months, Ja Morant's value around the league just had plummeted because of his play the last year, his unavailability as well, his injuries. So this is a team now in Memphis that is moving forward. They've got Cam Boozer, the number three pick. They've got a young team, they've got a ton of assets.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's decision to decline his player option for free agency
quotes.excerpt: The decision today to opt out of 27.7 million dollars is a stunner.
quotes.quote: I was tweeting out a signing right here, three years, 27 million dollar deal for Kevin Huerter to return to the Detroit Pistons. But as we go on this topic of Draymond Green, the decision today to opt out of 27.7 million dollars is a stunner because just days ago Mike Dunleavy Jr. said that Draymond Green would be opting in. They had full expectation of that, but the fact that he opted out, this now sets the team up with the flexibility to go for their grand plan.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' strategy to acquire LeBron James and Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: They have to potentially trade for Anthony Davis using Jimmy Butler and draft compensation.
quotes.quote: They have to potentially trade for Anthony Davis using Jimmy Butler and draft compensation. They've got two, three first-round picks they could potentially offer in a trade. Then they would have to secure the free agent commitment of LeBron James to then team up for this big four of Steph Curry, Draymond Green, LeBron James, and Anthony Davis.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Raptors and Clippers in serious trade talks for Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: Both sides remain in serious conversations. Toronto and the Clippers on getting a deal.
quotes.quote: Both sides remain in serious conversations. Toronto and the Clippers on getting a deal that sends Kawhi Leonard back to Toronto. And at the crux of this is Kawhi Leonard is in the last year of his deal, 2026-27 season at 50 million dollars. And my understanding is the Clippers will not be giving him a contract extension.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's preference to re-sign with the Toronto Raptors
quotes.excerpt: There's only one team that Kawhi Leonard wants to give a long-term contract extension to.
quotes.quote: There's only one team that Kawhi Leonard wants to give a long-term contract extension to. That's his former team, up north in the six, the Toronto Raptors. So what is this deal going to look like? It's probably going to involve a couple players, maybe a guy like Brandon Ingram, and it would have to have significant draft compensation.
